sections.value:
ROUND 1 performance verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES.
Subject: pr:321
Head: 40dafa4e6f62471e9ad8c19af52cac39f72195ca

Verified: for two WARM, CLEAN pooled fetches (schema PRAGMA plus one data query), the source model is10->4 SQLite-worker dispatch/reply operations,6->2 directly awaited by the caller. No new loop, periodic timer, process launch or launch site. The per-call schema brake is unchanged. No demonstrated normal-use cost breach blocks this head. Correct the generic "store call" and dirty "+1" accounting, and keep the offline result distinct from the owed batched-deploy AFTER.

Source accounting:

| Per reused clean lease | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| sqlx test-before-acquire ping |1 request-path worker command|0|
| pij before-acquire hook ping |1 request-path worker command|0|
| query execution |1 request-path command|1|
| pij after-release hook ping |1 release-task command|0 when tracked depth is zero|
| sqlx own return-to-pool ping |1 release-task command|1|
| Total |5 total,3 directly awaited|2 total,1 directly awaited|

Two such leases give the headline10->4/6->2. The benchmark calls only require_current_schema, ONE pooled PRAGMA lease: its model is5->2 total,3->1 directly awaited, not the full two-lease10->4 case.

Pinned primary sources were fetched/read through GitHub's API at launchbadge/sqlx tag v0.8.6 (Cargo.lock pins0.8.6):
- sqlx-core/src/pool/options.rs:149 defaults test_before_acquire=true; pool/inner.rs:469-498 invokes that ping and then before_acquire on a reused idle connection.
- sqlx-core/src/pool/connection.rs:275-326 runs after_release, then its own ping before returning a reusable connection. Closed/lifetime-expired/rejected connections are different paths, not this clean warm count.
- sqlx-sqlite/src/connection/mod.rs:246-247 delegates ping to the worker; connection/worker.rs:320-321 merely acknowledges Ping,405-406 dispatches it,354-376 dispatches query Execute. These pings are channel/worker synchronization, not SQL health queries. Worker-command count is not a literal OS wake/context-switch count: scheduling can coalesce work.
- sqlx-core/src/connection.rs:76-77 and sqlx-sqlite/src/transaction.rs:45-46 delegate is_in_transaction to the shared depth; worker.rs:45-46 is an atomic load. No worker round trip on the clean hook path. The hook still has its existing boxed future/Arc bookkeeping; "no round trip" is not zero allocation or zero CPU.
- worker.rs:210-249 rolls back an unacknowledged tracked Begin internally; worker.rs:394-401 distinguishes awaited rollback from fire-and-forget drop rollback. The tracked-depth/cancellation safety conclusion, raw SQL BEGIN and broken-storage behavior remain the separate correctness/security reviews; this cost pass does not clear them.

Non-blocking corrections:
1. Price by lease/operation shape. Multi-query snapshots, transactions, explicit preparation, connection creation and cleanup do not fit "every store call has two single-query leases." Removing acquire pings saves work per reused lease, not a5->2 multiplier for every statement inside an already-held transaction.
2. Dirty release is not universally "+1 total." The hook adds one flush ping if depth was nonzero; if D levels remain after flushing queued drop work, the loop adds D awaited rollback commands. A surviving one-level leak therefore adds a ping AND a rollback. If queued normal drop rollback has already cleaned the connection by the flush, only the extra hook ping remains. Source: crates/store/src/migrate.rs:84-102; pinned worker.rs:275-298,394-406. Retain the release cleanup, do not optimize it away.
3. "Two on the request path" means two directly initiated query commands for this clean two-lease read. Pool saturation can still make a caller wait for preceding borrowers' release work; it is not a guaranteed two-round-trip wall-latency budget.

Offline receipt verification:
bench.log records a release-profile test through shared-build, one passed test, median of3,000 require_current_schema calls in each of three rounds. Old/new medians:21.4/12.4us,27.7/11.2us,26.8/11.8us (42.06%,59.57%,55.97% lower in that recorded benchmark). These numbers match the PR. migrate.rs has no diff between the pre-merge43f20220 and this head. The throwaway benchmark source was deleted, so I verified retained output/arithmetic and the stated single-schema-call scope, not an independently rerunnable implementation/setup. Retain a tiny benchmark implementation/command receipt as a harness follow-up; this is not a code block.

BEFORE/AFTER:
The retained producer BEFORE JSON has two reported90s windows, PID41653:780 and752 whoamis,520 and501/min; daemon7.84%/8.09%, sqlx-sqlite-worker2.53%/2.61%, tokio4.94%/5.05%; whoami active396/414us, seat_list160/166us, role106/113us, fyi85/89us. The PR ties this to b88e1df937; the raw JSON itself does not stamp build/start/UTC. No AFTER saving is claimed.

AFTER remains owed: marten captures the matched thread-cpu.py/whoami windows and this performance seat verifies them. Pin deployed commit/PID/start, warm-up/age, elapsed windows, route/call and pane/activity cohorts. #318 is in the same bounce: report its observer capture/skip/backstop/byte changes separately from SQL-worker and whoami-stage changes. Normalize comparable demand; whole-daemon CPU alone cannot isolate this pool change. Keep the schema-read placement (option a); option b is not implemented or required.

Validation:
- just pr-freeze321 rechecked FINAL at the full head, CLEAN, latest five checks pass, schema49, no migration.
- Exact-head CI44905706938/job136850691678, successful upload artifact14707424698:2,811 tests passed overall,six skipped. Independently parsed JUnit:both pool-boundary regressions and all six spawn-site guards passed (8/8). Producer P1-P3 receipts are posted; reviewer did not rerun mutants.
- harness boot ready=false; harness checks --quick exit1 for eight absent-dependency/ambient-tool failures, native/SDK passing, heavy stages skipped. No reviewer green local gate; C25 exact-head TS CI proof. No installs/links.
- No source edits, local cargo build/benchmark run, second daemon, bounce, working-seat lapse/renewal, or direct access/write to the production SQLite file. Only provided log/JSON receipts and pinned public dependency source were read. Worktree clean; performance/321 held until merge.

The schema refusal is the unchanged BRAKE; removing it would admit more operations against an incompatible store. No new destructive/retention policy. Harness lesson: record pool-lease/worker-command counts and retain the tiny offline benchmark so future rounds verify the model without rediscovering sqlx internals.
